meta.title: Calisthenics exercises
meta.scope: Exercises where body weight provides the resistance, using at most simple apparatus (bar, rings, parallel bars, parallettes, box or bench, wall, pole). Added weight is treated as a modifier, not a separate entry.
meta.nomenclature: Common English names used in calisthenics, gymnastics, yoga, Pilates and military training; alternatives in 'aka'.
conventions: One entry per distinct named exercise: standard progression steps and well-known variations. Generic variables (tempo, pauses, band assistance, added load, etc.) are listed once under 'modifiers' instead of being multiplied across every exercise.

'equipment' lists alternatives: any one entry is enough. An entry joined with '+' (e.g. 'wall+parallettes') needs all of its items together. 'none' means no equipment; item names are keys of meta.equipment.
'step' is the exercise's position in a progression group (1 = easiest). It is omitted for groups that are not progressions.
'categories' lists every category and its groups in reading order; a group with 'progression': true runs easiest to hardest.
'level' and 'type' use the vocabularies defined in meta.levels and meta.types. Levels are approximate.

levels.beginner: Most healthy novices can do it now or within a few weeks.
levels.intermediate: Needs a base of roughly 10 push-ups and a few pull-ups (or the lower-body equivalent).
levels.advanced: Months to years of focused training.
levels.elite: Gymnastics-level strength or skill that few people ever reach.

types.plyometric: Explosive, usually with a flight phase.
types.conditioning: Done continuously to drive the heart rate up.
types.locomotion: Travels across the floor or apparatus.

categories.name: Push-ups
categories.description: Horizontal pushing: pressing the body away from the floor, a wall or rings.

categories.name: Overhead pressing & handstand push-ups
categories.description: Vertical pushing: pressing the body up overhead, from pike push-ups to one-arm handstand push-ups.

categories.name: Dips & support
categories.description: Pressing down on bars or rings: support holds, dips and their harder variants.

categories.name: Pull-ups & chin-ups
categories.description: Vertical pulling: hanging from a bar or rings and pulling the body up.

categories.name: Rows
categories.description: Horizontal pulling: pulling the chest toward a bar, rings or a fixed handhold.

categories.name: Arms, scapula & shoulder health
categories.description: Isolation and prehab: bodyweight curls, shoulder-blade control and rotator-cuff work.

categories.name: Muscle-ups & bar transitions
categories.description: Getting from below the bar or rings to above it, plus the swings, kips and circles of bar work.

categories.name: Levers, planche & flags
categories.description: Static straight-arm strength: holding the body horizontal (or sideways) off the floor, a bar, rings or a pole.

categories.name: Handstands, inversions & arm balances
categories.description: Balancing on the hands, head or forearms.

categories.name: Core
categories.description: Trunk strength: resisting and creating movement through the spine and pelvis.

categories.name: Legs: squats, lunges & single-leg
categories.description: Knee-dominant lower-body work, from assisted squats to pistols and shrimp squats.

categories.name: Posterior chain & hips
categories.description: Glutes, hamstrings, lower back and the smaller muscles around the hip.

categories.name: Calves, shins & feet
categories.description: Lower-leg and foot strength for the ankles, arches and toes.

categories.name: Neck
categories.description: Strength for the neck flexors, extensors and side benders, from isometrics to bridges.

categories.name: Grip, wrists & forearms
categories.description: Hand, finger and wrist strength from hangs, fingertip work and wrist loading.

categories.name: Plyometrics & jumps
categories.description: Explosive lower-body work: jumping, hopping, bounding and landing.

categories.name: Conditioning & cardio
categories.description: Continuous whole-body work that drives the heart rate up: jacks, running drills, climbers and burpees.

categories.name: Locomotion & animal movement
categories.description: Traveling on hands and feet: crawls, animal walks and Animal Flow.

categories.name: Tumbling & acrobatics
categories.description: Floor gymnastics and acrobatic skills done with body weight alone.

categories.name: Mobility & flexibility
categories.description: Active range-of-motion work and the flexibility skills calisthenics depends on.

groups.name: Classical mat sequence

exercises.name: Wall push-up
exercises.note: Hands on a wall, body leaning at a slight angle.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.note: Hands on a bench, box or bar; lower the surface over time to make it harder.

exercises.name: Knee push-up
exercises.note: Push-up from the knees with the hips kept straight.

exercises.name: Negative push-up
exercises.note: Lower slowly from the top, then reset from the knees.

exercises.name: Half push-up
exercises.note: Lower only until the elbows reach 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.note: Body straight, chest to the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso.

exercises.name: Decline push-up
exercises.note: Feet on a box; shifts work toward the upper chest and shoulders.

exercises.name: Deficit push-up
exercises.note: Hands on parallettes or blocks so the chest sinks below the hands.

exercises.name: Wide push-up
exercises.note: Hands well outside the shoulders; works the chest and triceps a little less than the standard push-up.

exercises.name: Close-grip push-up
exercises.note: Hands under the shoulders, elbows brushing the ribs: more triceps.

exercises.name: Diamond push-up
exercises.note: Thumbs and index fingers touch to form a diamond under the chest.

exercises.name: Staggered push-up
exercises.note: One hand forward and one back; switch sides each set.

exercises.name: Knuckle push-up
exercises.note: On the fists with the wrists straight.

exercises.name: Fingertip push-up
exercises.note: On spread fingertips; strengthens the fingers and hands.

exercises.name: Reverse-hand push-up
exercises.note: Fingers point back toward the feet; loads the wrists and biceps as planche prep.

exercises.name: Archer push-up
exercises.note: Lower toward one hand while the other arm stays straight out to the side.

exercises.name: Typewriter push-up
exercises.note: At the bottom, slide from one hand to the other before pressing up.

exercises.name: Uneven push-up
exercises.note: One hand on a raised block or ball, the other on the floor.

exercises.name: Incline one-arm push-up
exercises.note: One-arm push-up with the hand on a bench or bar; lower the surface to progress.

exercises.name: Lever push-up
exercises.note: One hand pushes while the other arm rests straight out on a ball or block.

exercises.name: Half one-arm push-up
exercises.note: One-arm push-up through the top half of the range.

exercises.name: One-arm push-up
exercises.note: Feet wide, working hand under the chest, free hand behind the back.

exercises.name: One-arm one-leg push-up
exercises.note: One-arm push-up with the opposite foot lifted off the floor.

exercises.name: Ring push-up
exercises.note: Rings a few inches off the floor; the unstable handles work the stabilizers harder.

exercises.name: RTO ring push-up
exercises.note: Finish each rep with the rings turned out, palms facing forward.

exercises.name: Archer ring push-up
exercises.note: One ring slides out to the side while the other arm pushes.

exercises.name: Bulgarian ring push-up
exercises.note: Let the rings travel wide at the bottom for a deep, fly-like stretch.

exercises.name: RTO pseudo planche push-up
exercises.note: Ring push-up with the rings turned out and the shoulders leaning well past the hands.

exercises.name: Lalanne push-up
exercises.note: Hands far out in front of the head; the body stays almost straight on a very long lever.

exercises.name: Hand-release push-up
exercises.note: Chest to the floor, lift the hands briefly, then press up.

exercises.name: Shoulder-tap push-up
exercises.note: Tap the opposite shoulder at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Single-leg push-up
exercises.note: One foot held off the floor for the whole set.

exercises.name: Push-up jack
exercises.note: Jump the feet wide and back together with each rep.

exercises.name: Push-up to downward dog
exercises.note: After each push-up, push the hips up and back into a pike.

exercises.name: Walk-out push-up
exercises.note: Walk the hands out to a plank, do a push-up, walk back and stand.

exercises.name: T push-up
exercises.note: Rotate into a side plank at the top, one arm to the ceiling.

exercises.name: Spider-man push-up
exercises.note: Bring one knee to the same-side elbow as you lower.

exercises.name: Walking push-up
exercises.note: Walk the hands and feet sideways between reps.

exercises.name: Chaturanga
exercises.note: Hold the bottom of a push-up a few inches off the floor, elbows hugging the ribs.

exercises.name: Hindu push-up
exercises.note: From a pike, swoop the chest low along the floor up into a cobra, then push the hips straight back.

exercises.name: Dive bomber push-up
exercises.note: Swoop from a pike through a low arch into a cobra, then reverse the same path.

exercises.name: Incline plyo push-up
exercises.note: Push off a bench or wall hard enough for the hands to leave it.

exercises.name: Kneeling plyo push-up
exercises.note: From the knees, push hard enough for the hands to leave the floor.

exercises.name: Plyo push-up
exercises.note: Push hard enough for the hands to leave the floor.

exercises.name: Clap push-up
exercises.note: Clap once in the air before landing.

exercises.name: Lateral plyo push-up
exercises.note: Explode sideways so the body travels across the floor.

exercises.name: Depth push-up
exercises.note: Drop from two raised blocks to the floor and rebound straight back up.

exercises.name: Chest-slap push-up
exercises.note: Slap the chest in the air before landing.

exercises.name: Hip-slap push-up
exercises.note: Slap the hips or thighs in the air before landing.

exercises.name: Double-clap push-up
exercises.note: Two claps in the air before landing.

exercises.name: Behind-the-back clap push-up
exercises.note: Clap behind the back in the air before landing.

exercises.name: Full-body pop-up
exercises.note: Hands and feet leave the floor at the same moment.

exercises.name: Triple-clap push-up
exercises.note: Three claps in the air before landing.

exercises.name: Aztec push-up
exercises.note: Explode up, pike in the air to touch the toes, and land back in a plank.

exercises.name: Superman push-up
exercises.note: Launch the whole body off the floor with the arms flying forward overhead, then land in a push-up.

exercises.name: Ring fly
exercises.note: From a ring push-up position, let the arms open wide with soft elbows, then squeeze back.

exercises.name: Slider fly
exercises.note: From a push-up or kneeling position, slide the hands apart and back together.

exercises.name: Dolphin push-up
exercises.note: From a forearm plank, push the hips up into a pike on the forearms, then return.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.note: Hips high in an inverted V; lower the head to the floor just in front of the hands.

exercises.name: Elevated pike push-up
exercises.note: Feet on a box so the torso is closer to vertical.

exercises.name: Deficit pike push-up
exercises.note: Hands on parallettes or blocks so the head can sink below the hands.

exercises.name: Box pike push-up
exercises.note: Knees or feet on a box with the hips stacked over the shoulders.

exercises.name: Handstand push-up negative
exercises.note: Lower slowly from a wall handstand to the head, then come down.

exercises.name: Half handstand push-up
exercises.note: Wall handstand push-up through the top half of the range.

exercises.name: Kipping handstand push-up
exercises.note: Drive the legs up from the bottom to help finish the press (CrossFit style).

exercises.name: Wall handstand push-up
exercises.note: Back to the wall, lower the head to the floor and press back to straight arms.

exercises.name: Chest-to-wall handstand push-up
exercises.note: Facing the wall, which forces a straighter body line.

exercises.name: Close-grip handstand push-up
exercises.note: Hands close together; more triceps, harder balance.

exercises.name: Deficit handstand push-up
exercises.note: Hands on parallettes or plates so the head sinks below the hands.

exercises.name: Freestanding handstand push-up
exercises.note: No wall: balance and press in the open.

exercises.name: Ring handstand push-up
exercises.note: Handstand push-up on rings, often braced against the straps at first.

exercises.name: Uneven handstand push-up
exercises.note: One hand raised on a block or ball, shifting most of the load to the lower hand.

exercises.name: 90-degree push-up
exercises.note: From a handstand, lower into a bent-arm planche with the body horizontal, then press back up.

exercises.name: Tiger bend push-up
exercises.note: From a handstand, lower onto the forearms and press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: One-arm handstand push-up
exercises.note: Wall-supported one-arm press; very few people have ever done a strict rep.

exercises.name: Parallel bar support
exercises.note: Arms locked, shoulders pushed down away from the ears.

exercises.name: Straight bar support
exercises.note: Front support on a single bar at the hips, arms straight.

exercises.name: Bottom dip hold
exercises.note: Hold the lowest point of a dip, shoulders just below the elbows.

exercises.name: Ring support hold
exercises.note: Rings pressed against the sides, arms locked, fighting the rings drifting away.

exercises.name: RTO ring support
exercises.note: Ring support with the rings turned out so the palms face forward.

exercises.name: Floor dip
exercises.note: Seated in a reverse tabletop with hands behind you; bend and straighten the arms.

exercises.name: Bench dip
exercises.note: Hands on a bench behind you, feet on the floor; keep the depth moderate.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated bench dip
exercises.note: Bench dip with the feet up on a second bench.

exercises.name: Negative dip
exercises.note: Lower slowly from the top of the bars.

exercises.name: Parallel bar dip
exercises.note: Lower until the shoulders pass below the elbows; lean forward for chest, stay upright for triceps.

exercises.name: Straight bar dip
exercises.note: Dip on a single bar in front of the hips; a key muscle-up strength.

exercises.name: Ring dip
exercises.note: Dip on rings, keeping them close to the body.

exercises.name: L-sit dip
exercises.note: Dip while holding the legs straight out in an L.

exercises.name: Korean dip
exercises.note: Dip on a straight bar with the bar behind the body.

exercises.name: Russian dip
exercises.note: At the bottom of a dip, roll back onto the forearms, then return and press out.

exercises.name: RTO ring dip
exercises.note: Ring dip finishing each rep with the rings turned out.

exercises.name: Bulgarian ring dip
exercises.note: Let the rings travel wide at the bottom for a deep, fly-like range.

exercises.name: Impossible dip
exercises.note: From the forearms resting along the bars, press up to straight arms without swinging: the dip-bar cousin of the tiger bend.

exercises.name: Sphinx push-up
exercises.note: From a forearm plank, press up onto the hands by straightening only the elbows.

exercises.name: Bodyweight triceps extension
exercises.note: Hands on a bar, bench or rings; bend the elbows to bring the head under the hands, then extend.

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.note: Hang with straight arms and relaxed shoulders.

exercises.name: Active hang
exercises.note: Straight arms with the shoulders pulled down away from the ears.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-up
exercises.note: From a dead hang, pull the shoulder blades down and back without bending the arms.

exercises.name: Flexed-arm hang
exercises.note: Hold the chin above the bar.

exercises.name: Arch hang
exercises.note: Hang with the chest pushed toward the bar and the shoulder blades squeezed together.

exercises.name: Jumping pull-up
exercises.note: Jump to the top position, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Negative pull-up
exercises.note: Start with the chin over the bar and lower as slowly as possible.

exercises.name: Assisted pull-up
exercises.note: A band, a box under the feet or a partner takes part of the weight.

exercises.name: Half pull-up
exercises.note: Pull-ups through the top half of the range only.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.note: Palms facing you, hands about shoulder width; more biceps.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip pull-up
exercises.note: Palms facing each other on parallel handles.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.note: Palms facing away, hands a little wider than the shoulders; chin clears the bar.

exercises.name: Wide-grip pull-up
exercises.note: Hands well outside the shoulders; shorter range, more lats.

exercises.name: Close-grip pull-up
exercises.note: Hands close together.

exercises.name: Mixed-grip pull-up
exercises.note: One hand overhand, one underhand; switch sides each set.

exercises.name: Commando pull-up
exercises.note: Stand under the bar lengthwise with the hands close and staggered; pull the head to alternate sides.

exercises.name: Ring pull-up
exercises.note: On rings, which let the hands rotate freely.

exercises.name: Chest-to-bar pull-up
exercises.note: Pull until the chest touches the bar.

exercises.name: Behind-the-neck pull-up
exercises.note: Pull the bar behind the head; needs good shoulder mobility.

exercises.name: L-sit pull-up
exercises.note: Pull-up while holding the legs straight out in an L.

exercises.name: Towel pull-up
exercises.note: Pull-up holding towels draped over the bar; very hard on the grip.

exercises.name: Sternum pull-up
exercises.note: Lean back and pull until the lower chest touches the bar.

exercises.name: Archer pull-up
exercises.note: Pull toward one hand while the other arm straightens along the bar.

exercises.name: Typewriter pull-up
exercises.note: At the top, slide from one hand to the other with the chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Around-the-world pull-up
exercises.note: Trace a circle over the bar: up on one side, across the top, down the other.

exercises.name: Uneven pull-up
exercises.note: One hand on the bar, the other lower on a towel or strap.

exercises.name: Assisted one-arm pull-up
exercises.note: One hand on the bar; the other helps as little as possible from a towel, the wrist or fingertips.

exercises.name: One-arm negative
exercises.note: Lower from the top on one arm as slowly as possible.

exercises.name: One-arm pull-up
exercises.note: Pull-up on one arm; usually done with an underhand or neutral grip.

exercises.name: Kipping pull-up
exercises.note: A hip swing helps drive the body up (CrossFit style).

exercises.name: Butterfly pull-up
exercises.note: A continuous cycling kip that circles the body under the bar (CrossFit style).

exercises.name: Explosive pull-up
exercises.note: Pull as fast as possible, aiming the chest past the bar.

exercises.name: High pull-up
exercises.note: Pull explosively until the bar reaches the waist; the bridge to a muscle-up.

exercises.name: Clap pull-up
exercises.note: Let go at the top, clap, and catch the bar.

exercises.name: Switch-grip pull-up
exercises.note: Let go at the top and switch from overhand to underhand before catching.

exercises.name: Headbanger pull-up
exercises.note: At the top, push the body back from the bar and pull it in again without dropping.

exercises.name: Monkey-bar traverse
exercises.note: Swing hand over hand along a row of rungs.

exercises.name: Lateral bar traverse
exercises.note: Shuffle the hands sideways along a single bar without letting go with both.

exercises.name: Heel hook
exercises.note: From an alternating-grip hang, pull with the arms, lift the feet over the bar and cross the ankles around it; lower slowly (Army drill).

exercises.name: Rope climb
exercises.note: Climb the rope using a foot lock or leg wrap.

exercises.name: Legless rope climb
exercises.note: Climb the rope with the arms alone.

exercises.name: Door-frame row
exercises.note: Hold both sides of a door frame, lean back with straight arms and pull yourself in.

exercises.name: Table row
exercises.note: Lie under a sturdy table, grip the edge and pull the chest up to it.

exercises.name: Incline row
exercises.note: Rings or a high bar with the body at a steep angle; walk the feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: Bent-knee inverted row
exercises.note: Inverted row with the knees bent and the feet flat on the floor.

exercises.name: Inverted row
exercises.note: Body straight under a hip-height bar or rings, heels down; pull the chest to the hands.

exercises.name: Underhand inverted row
exercises.note: Palms facing you; more biceps.

exercises.name: Wide-grip inverted row
exercises.note: Hands wide; more upper back and rear delts.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated inverted row
exercises.note: Feet on a box so the body is horizontal or tilted head-down.

exercises.name: Archer row
exercises.note: Row toward one hand while the other arm stays straight.

exercises.name: One-arm inverted row
exercises.note: Row on one hand, keeping the hips and shoulders square.

exercises.name: Ring face pull
exercises.note: Lean back from the rings and pull them toward the forehead, elbows high and wide.

exercises.name: Ring reverse fly
exercises.note: Lean back holding the rings with straight arms and open them into a T.

exercises.name: Ring Y-raise
exercises.note: Lean back and raise the straight arms overhead into a Y.

exercises.name: Ring W-raise
exercises.note: Pull the rings back and apart with bent elbows, squeezing the shoulder blades into a W.

exercises.name: Scapular row
exercises.note: In an inverted-row position, pinch the shoulder blades together and apart without bending the arms.

exercises.name: Bodyweight biceps curl
exercises.note: Lean back holding rings or a low bar, palms up, and curl the body in toward the hands.

exercises.name: Pelican curl
exercises.note: Rings behind the body: lean forward on straight arms, then curl back up with the biceps.

exercises.name: Scapular push-up
exercises.note: In a plank, let the chest sink between the shoulder blades, then push the floor away.

exercises.name: Scapular dip
exercises.note: In a dip support, let the shoulders rise toward the ears, then press them down.

exercises.name: Scapular wall slide
exercises.note: Arms against a wall, slide them up and down without losing contact.

exercises.name: Prone I raise
exercises.note: Face down, raise the straight arms overhead in line with the body.

exercises.name: Prone Y raise
exercises.note: Face down, raise the straight arms overhead in a Y, thumbs up.

exercises.name: Prone T raise
exercises.note: Face down, raise the straight arms out to the sides in a T.

exercises.name: Prone W raise
exercises.note: Face down with bent elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades to lift the arms into a W.

exercises.name: Prone L raise
exercises.note: Face down with elbows bent 90 degrees, rotate the forearms up to lift the hands.

exercises.name: Prone row
exercises.note: Face down, pull the elbows back as if rowing and squeeze the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Reverse snow angel
exercises.note: Face down, sweep the straight arms from the hips to overhead and back, hovering them off the floor.

exercises.name: Handstand shrug
exercises.note: In a wall handstand, push tall through the shoulders, then sink, without bending the arms.

exercises.name: Low-bar muscle-up
exercises.note: On a chest-height bar with the feet helping, practice pulling up and turning over the bar.

exercises.name: Ring transition drill
exercises.note: Rings low and feet on the floor: lean back in a false grip and roll the chest over the hands into a dip.

exercises.name: False-grip hang
exercises.note: Hang with the wrists wrapped over the rings so the heels of the hands carry the weight.

exercises.name: False-grip row
exercises.note: Inverted ring row keeping the false grip throughout.

exercises.name: Jumping muscle-up
exercises.note: Jump to help carry the body over the bar, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Negative muscle-up
exercises.note: From the support on top, lower slowly through the transition to a hang.

exercises.name: Kipping muscle-up
exercises.note: A swing drives the hips up and the chest over the bar.

exercises.name: Muscle-up
exercises.note: Strict pull from a dead hang, through the transition, to a dip-out on top of the bar.

exercises.name: Kipping ring muscle-up
exercises.note: Swing-assisted muscle-up on rings.

exercises.name: Ring muscle-up
exercises.note: Strict muscle-up on rings using a false grip.

exercises.name: Wide-grip muscle-up
exercises.note: Hands well outside the shoulders, making the transition longer and harder.

exercises.name: L-sit muscle-up
exercises.note: Muscle-up with the legs held straight out in an L throughout.

exercises.name: Slow muscle-up
exercises.note: A deliberately slow, strict muscle-up with no swing anywhere.

exercises.name: Reverse-grip muscle-up
exercises.note: Muscle-up with the palms facing you.

exercises.name: Clap muscle-up
exercises.note: Explode high enough over the bar to clap before catching the support.

exercises.name: Hefesto
exercises.note: From a German hang with the arms straight behind you, curl up until the bar sits behind your back in a Korean-dip support: a backward muscle-up.

exercises.name: One-arm muscle-up
exercises.note: Muscle-up on one arm; only a small number of athletes have done one.
