exercises.note: A controlled hollow-to-arch swing that builds the rhythm for kips and releases.

exercises.name: Pull-over
exercises.note: From a hang, pull the hips up and over the bar to finish in a front support.

exercises.name: Back hip circle
exercises.note: From a front support, circle backward around the bar with the hips against it.

exercises.name: Cast
exercises.note: From a front support, swing the legs back and push the hips away so the body rises off the bar.

exercises.name: Front hip circle
exercises.note: From a front support, fall forward around the bar and circle back up to support.

exercises.name: Glide kip
exercises.note: Glide forward under the bar, bring the ankles to it, then pull through to a front support.

exercises.name: Back uprise
exercises.note: Use the backswing to rise from a hang or upper-arm hang up to a support.

exercises.name: Front uprise
exercises.note: Use the forward swing to rise from a hang up to a support.

exercises.name: Inlocate
exercises.note: On rings, rotate backward around the shoulders from a hang into an inverted pike.

exercises.name: Dislocate
exercises.note: On rings, shoot the legs up and out from an inverted pike and rotate forward to a hang, arms turning out.

exercises.name: Clear hip circle
exercises.note: A back hip circle with the hips clear of the bar, finishing near a handstand.

exercises.name: Giant swing
exercises.note: A full circle around the bar in a straight, handstand-like line.

exercises.name: Swing 180
exercises.note: From a swing, let go and turn 180 degrees to regrab the bar facing the other way.

exercises.name: 360 pull-up
exercises.note: Explosive pull-up, let go, spin a full turn in the air and regrab the bar.

exercises.name: Swing 360
exercises.note: From a swing, let go, spin a full turn and regrab.

exercises.name: Planche lean
exercises.note: From a straight-arm push-up position, lean the shoulders well forward of the hands.

exercises.name: Tuck planche
exercises.note: Knees tucked to the chest, hips at shoulder height, feet off the floor.

exercises.name: Advanced tuck planche
exercises.note: Tuck planche with a flat back and the hips pushed out behind.

exercises.name: One-leg planche
exercises.note: One leg straight behind, the other tucked.

exercises.name: 90-degree hold
exercises.note: Hold a bent-arm planche: elbows at 90 degrees, body straight and horizontal.

exercises.name: Straddle planche
exercises.note: Legs straight and spread wide.

exercises.name: Half-lay planche
exercises.note: Hips extended with the knees bent, a shorter lever than the full planche.

exercises.name: Full planche
exercises.note: Body straight and horizontal, balanced on straight arms.

exercises.name: Floor maltese
exercises.note: Planche with the hands wide and turned out near the hips, the body just above the floor.

exercises.name: One-arm planche
exercises.note: A planche balanced on one arm; only a handful of people have held one.

exercises.name: Pseudo planche push-up
exercises.note: Push-up with the hands by the hips and the shoulders leaning well past them.

exercises.name: Tuck planche push-up
exercises.note: Push-ups while holding a tuck planche.

exercises.name: Advanced tuck planche push-up
exercises.note: Push-ups while holding an advanced tuck planche.

exercises.name: Straddle planche push-up
exercises.note: Push-ups while holding a straddle planche.

exercises.name: Full planche push-up
exercises.note: Push-ups while holding a full planche.

exercises.name: Maltese push-up
exercises.note: Planche push-up with the hands wide by the hips and the body skimming the floor.

exercises.name: Planche press to handstand
exercises.note: From a planche, press up to a handstand without bending the arms.

exercises.name: Tuck front lever
exercises.note: Under the bar on straight arms, knees tucked to the chest, back horizontal.

exercises.name: Advanced tuck front lever
exercises.note: Tuck with a flat back and the hips opened to 90 degrees.

exercises.name: One-leg front lever
exercises.note: One leg straight, the other tucked.

exercises.name: Straddle front lever
exercises.note: Legs straight and spread wide.

exercises.name: Half-lay front lever
exercises.note: Hips straight, knees bent.

exercises.name: Front lever
exercises.note: Body straight and horizontal under the bar, face up, arms straight.

exercises.name: One-arm front lever
exercises.note: A front lever held on one arm.

exercises.name: Tuck front lever row
exercises.note: Hold a tuck front lever and row the chest to the bar.

exercises.name: Front lever raise
exercises.note: From a hang, raise the straight body to front-lever height with straight arms.

exercises.name: Ice cream maker
exercises.note: From the top of a pull-up, extend the arms and lower into a front lever, then pull back up.

exercises.name: Advanced tuck front lever row
exercises.note: Rows while holding an advanced tuck front lever.

exercises.name: Straddle front lever row
exercises.note: Rows while holding a straddle front lever.

exercises.name: Front lever row
exercises.note: Row the chest to the bar while holding a full front lever.

exercises.name: Front lever pull-up
exercises.note: Pull the bar down toward the hips while the body stays horizontal in a front lever.

exercises.name: Inverted hang
exercises.note: Hang upside down with the body and arms straight.

exercises.name: German hang
exercises.note: From an inverted hang, lower the hips behind until the arms stretch back behind the body.

exercises.name: Skin the cat
exercises.note: From a hang, tuck and rotate backward through an inverted hang into a German hang, then return.

exercises.name: Tuck back lever
exercises.note: Face down under the rings, knees tucked, back horizontal, arms straight.

exercises.name: Advanced tuck back lever
exercises.note: Tuck with a flat back and the hips opened.

exercises.name: Straddle back lever
exercises.note: Legs straight and spread wide.

exercises.name: Half-lay back lever
exercises.note: Hips straight, knees bent.

exercises.name: Back lever
exercises.note: Body straight and horizontal, face down, arms straight behind the body.

exercises.name: Back lever pull-out
exercises.note: From a German hang, pull through the back lever up to an inverted hang.

exercises.name: One-arm back lever
exercises.note: A back lever held on one arm.

exercises.name: Clutch flag
exercises.note: Hug the pole with the top arm and shoulder while the bottom arm presses; hold the body out sideways.

exercises.name: Vertical flag
exercises.note: Top arm pulls, bottom arm pushes, body held straight up beside the pole.

exercises.name: Tuck human flag
exercises.note: Knees tucked with the torso horizontal beside the pole.

exercises.name: Straddle human flag
exercises.note: Legs straight and spread.

exercises.name: Human flag
exercises.note: Body straight and horizontal, held out from the pole by the arms alone.

exercises.name: Human flag raise
exercises.note: Raise the straight body from vertical to horizontal and back.

exercises.name: Ring planche
exercises.note: A full planche on rings, rings turned out.

exercises.name: Iron cross
exercises.note: Hang with the arms straight out to the sides, hands level with the shoulders.

exercises.name: Inverted cross
exercises.note: An iron cross held upside down.

exercises.name: Azarian
exercises.note: A slow, straight-arm backward roll that finishes in an iron cross.

exercises.name: Nakayama
exercises.note: Rise from a back lever up into an iron cross with straight arms.

exercises.name: Maltese
exercises.note: Face-down horizontal hold with straight arms spread wide and the rings near the hips.

exercises.name: Victorian
exercises.note: Face-up horizontal hold at ring height, straight arms angled out from the sides with the rings near the hips: an upside-down maltese.

exercises.name: Box pike hold
exercises.note: Feet on a box with the hips stacked over the shoulders and the arms straight.

exercises.name: Wall walk
exercises.note: From a push-up position with the feet at the wall, walk the feet up and the hands in, then back down.

exercises.name: Chest-to-wall handstand
exercises.note: Walk up the wall facing it and hold a straight line.

exercises.name: Back-to-wall handstand
exercises.note: Kick up with the back to the wall and hold.

exercises.name: Handstand kick-up
exercises.note: Kick up from a lunge into a handstand, alternating the lead leg.

exercises.name: Wall handstand shoulder tap
exercises.note: Chest to the wall, shift onto one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.

exercises.name: Heel pull
exercises.note: In a back-to-wall handstand, pull the heels off the wall to find balance.

exercises.name: Toe pull
exercises.note: In a chest-to-wall handstand, pull the toes off the wall to find balance.

exercises.name: Freestanding handstand
exercises.note: A straight handstand in the open, balanced through the fingers and wrists.

exercises.name: Tuck handstand
exercises.note: A handstand with the knees tucked to the chest.

exercises.name: Straddle handstand
exercises.note: A handstand with the legs spread wide.

exercises.name: Handstand walk
exercises.note: Walk on the hands forward, backward or sideways.

exercises.name: Parallette handstand
exercises.note: A handstand on parallettes, balancing through the grip.

exercises.name: Handstand pirouette
exercises.note: Walk the hands around in a turn while staying in the handstand.

exercises.name: Ring handstand
exercises.note: A handstand on rings, usually learned with the feet braced on the straps first.

exercises.name: Hollowback handstand
exercises.note: A handstand with the legs lowered behind and the back deeply arched.

exercises.name: One-arm handstand
exercises.note: A handstand balanced on one hand.

exercises.name: Headstand to handstand press
exercises.note: From a tripod headstand, press the head off the floor into a handstand.

exercises.name: Tuck press to handstand
exercises.note: From a tuck or crow, lift the hips and legs up into a handstand.

exercises.name: Straddle press to handstand
exercises.note: From standing or a straddle sit, lift the straight legs up to a handstand without jumping.

exercises.name: Pike press to handstand
exercises.note: Lift straight, closed legs from a pike up to a handstand.

exercises.name: L-sit to handstand press
exercises.note: From an L-sit on the floor or parallettes, press up to a handstand.

exercises.name: Stalder press
exercises.note: Press from a straddle sit with the legs outside the arms up to a handstand.

exercises.name: Shoulder stand
exercises.note: On the upper back with the hips and legs straight up, hands supporting the back.

exercises.name: Tripod headstand
exercises.note: Head and hands form a triangle on the floor; stack the hips, then raise the legs.

exercises.name: Forearm headstand
exercises.note: Forearms on the floor with the fingers laced around the back of the head.

exercises.name: Forearm stand
exercises.note: Balance on the forearms with the head off the floor.

exercises.name: Ring shoulder stand
exercises.note: Support on the rings with the shoulders down beside them and the body straight up.

exercises.name: Scorpion pose
exercises.note: A forearm stand with the back arched and the feet lowered toward the head.

exercises.name: Frog stand
exercises.note: Squat with the hands down and the knees resting on the elbows; lean forward until the feet lift.

exercises.name: Crow pose
exercises.note: Knees on the backs of the upper arms; lean forward and lift the feet.

exercises.name: Side crow
exercises.note: Twist so both knees rest on one upper arm, then balance.

exercises.name: Crane pose
exercises.note: A crow on straight arms with the knees high on the upper arms.

exercises.name: Pendant pose
exercises.note: Kneel with the ankles crossed, then press the hands down to lift the knees and feet.

exercises.name: Eight-angle pose
exercises.note: Legs hooked around one arm and crossed at the ankles, body leaning forward on bent arms.

exercises.name: Firefly pose
exercises.note: From a wide squat, sit the thighs on the arms and extend the legs forward off the floor.

exercises.name: Shoulder-pressing pose
exercises.note: Legs wrapped over the upper arms with the ankles crossed in front, feet off the floor.

exercises.name: Elephant's trunk pose
exercises.note: One leg hooked over the upper arm and the other straight forward, both lifted with the hips.

exercises.name: Scale pose
exercises.note: Seated in lotus, press the hands down beside the hips and lift the whole body.

exercises.name: Elbow lever
exercises.note: Elbows pressed into the hips, body horizontal and balanced on the hands.

exercises.name: Flying pigeon
exercises.note: One shin across the upper arms, the other leg extended straight back.

exercises.name: Flying splits
exercises.note: Balanced on bent arms with one leg extended forward over an arm and the other straight back.

exercises.name: Rooster pose
exercises.note: In lotus, thread the arms through the gaps between the thighs and calves and lift.

exercises.name: Peacock pose
exercises.note: Hands together with the fingers turned back, elbows in the belly, body horizontal.

exercises.name: One-arm elbow lever
exercises.note: An elbow lever balanced on one arm.

exercises.name: Forearm plank
exercises.note: Forearms and toes, body straight from head to heels.

exercises.name: High plank
exercises.note: The top of a push-up, held.

exercises.name: Bear plank
exercises.note: On hands and toes with the knees hovering just off the floor.

exercises.name: Single-leg plank
exercises.note: A plank with one foot lifted.

exercises.name: Plank shoulder tap
exercises.note: In a high plank, tap each hand to the opposite shoulder without rocking the hips.

exercises.name: Plank up-down
exercises.note: Move from forearm plank to high plank one arm at a time, and back.

exercises.name: Spider-man plank
exercises.note: From a high plank, bring a knee to the same-side elbow and return.

exercises.name: Two-point plank
exercises.note: A high plank with the opposite arm and leg lifted.

exercises.name: RKC plank
exercises.note: Forearm plank with maximal tension: elbows pulled toward the toes, glutes and thighs squeezed.

exercises.name: Long-lever plank
exercises.note: Forearm plank with the elbows well in front of the shoulders.

exercises.name: Body saw
exercises.note: In a forearm plank, rock the body forward and back from the shoulders.

exercises.name: Slider knee tuck
exercises.note: In a high plank with the feet on sliders, pull the knees to the chest.

exercises.name: Slider pike
exercises.note: In a high plank with the feet on sliders, pike the hips up, then return.

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout
exercises.note: From the knees, roll out until the body is nearly straight, then pull back.

exercises.name: Ring rollout
exercises.note: Hands on low rings, let the arms travel overhead as the body leans forward, then pull back.

exercises.name: Standing ab wheel rollout
exercises.note: From standing, roll out to full extension just above the floor and back.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.note: On the back with arms and knees up, lower the opposite arm and leg while the low back stays down.

exercises.name: Tuck hollow hold
exercises.note: On the back, knees tucked, shoulders and feet off the floor, low back pressed down.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.note: Arms overhead and legs straight, both hovering off the floor, low back pressed down.

exercises.name: Boat pose
exercises.note: Balanced on the sit bones in a V, legs raised and torso leaning back, arms reaching forward; bend the knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Hollow rock
exercises.note: Rock back and forth while keeping the hollow shape.

exercises.name: Hollow-to-arch roll
exercises.note: Roll from a hollow hold onto the front into an arch hold and back without touching down.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.note: Curl the shoulders off the floor while the low back stays down.

exercises.name: Reverse crunch
exercises.note: Curl the hips off the floor toward the ribs.

exercises.name: Toe-touch crunch
exercises.note: Legs straight up; reach the hands toward the toes.

exercises.name: Sit-up
exercises.note: Curl all the way up from lying to sitting.

exercises.name: Butterfly sit-up
exercises.note: Soles together and knees out; sit up and reach past the feet.

exercises.name: Rower
exercises.note: From lying with arms overhead, sit up while pulling the knees in and reaching the arms forward.

exercises.name: Tuck-up
exercises.note: Balanced on the hips, bring the knees and chest together, then extend.

exercises.name: V-up
exercises.note: From lying flat, lift the straight legs and torso together to touch the toes.

exercises.name: Janda sit-up
exercises.note: A sit-up with the heels pulled into the floor to quiet the hip flexors.

exercises.name: Decline sit-up
exercises.note: A sit-up on a decline bench with the feet anchored.

exercises.name: GHD sit-up
exercises.note: Hips on the pad, lower back past parallel, then sit up.

exercises.name: Lying knee raise
exercises.note: On the back, bring the bent knees toward the chest and lower.

exercises.name: Flutter kick
exercises.note: Legs straight and hovering; kick them up and down in small, quick strokes.

exercises.name: Scissor kick
exercises.note: Legs hovering; cross them over and under each other.

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
exercises.note: Raise the straight legs to vertical and lower without arching the back.

exercises.name: Parallel-bar knee raise
exercises.note: Supported on dip bars, raise the knees toward the chest.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.note: Hang from the bar and raise the knees to the chest.

exercises.name: Parallel-bar leg raise
exercises.note: Supported on dip bars, raise the straight legs to horizontal.

exercises.name: Knees-to-elbows
exercises.note: Hang and bring the knees up to touch the elbows.

exercises.name: Leg tuck
exercises.note: From an alternating-grip hang, pull with the arms and raise the knees until the elbows touch the thighs, then lower (Army test event).

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.note: Hang and raise the straight legs to at least horizontal.

exercises.name: Toes-to-bar
exercises.note: Hang and raise the straight legs until the toes touch the bar.

exercises.name: Tuck dragon flag
exercises.note: A dragon flag with the knees tucked.

exercises.name: Dragon flag negative
exercises.note: From a shoulder stand on a bench, lower the straight body slowly, pivoting on the upper back.

exercises.name: Straddle dragon flag
exercises.note: A dragon flag with the legs straight and spread wide.

exercises.name: Dragon flag
exercises.note: Holding a bench behind the head, lower and raise the straight body with only the upper back touching.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.note: On one forearm and the side of the feet, body straight.

exercises.name: Knee side plank
exercises.note: A side plank from the knees.

exercises.name: Side plank hip dip
exercises.note: In a side plank, lower the hip toward the floor and lift it back.

exercises.name: Side plank reach-through
exercises.note: In a side plank, thread the top arm under the body and back up.

exercises.name: Russian twist
exercises.note: Seated and leaning back, rotate the torso side to side.

exercises.name: Bicycle crunch
exercises.note: Bring each elbow toward the opposite knee while the other leg extends.

exercises.name: Oblique crunch
exercises.note: With the knees dropped to one side, crunch the ribs toward the hip.

exercises.name: Heel touch
exercises.note: On the back with knees bent, lift the shoulders slightly and reach side to side to touch the heels.

exercises.name: Leg tuck and twist
exercises.note: Seated and leaning back, pull the knees in toward one shoulder, then the other.

exercises.name: Standing knee-to-elbow
exercises.note: Standing, bring each knee up to the opposite elbow.

exercises.name: Plank hip twist
exercises.note: In a forearm plank, rotate the hips to dip toward each side.

exercises.name: Star plank
exercises.note: A side plank on a straight arm with the top arm and leg raised.

exercises.name: Bent-knee windshield wiper
exercises.note: On the back with the knees bent at 90 degrees over the hips, lower them side to side.

exercises.name: Lying windshield wiper
exercises.note: On the back with the legs straight up, lower them side to side under control.

exercises.name: Hanging oblique knee raise
exercises.note: Hanging, raise the knees toward one side, then the other.

exercises.name: Hanging windshield wiper
exercises.note: Hanging with the feet raised to the bar, swing the legs from side to side.

exercises.name: Seated pike leg lift
exercises.note: Sit in a pike with the hands beside the knees and lift both heels off the floor.

exercises.name: Foot-supported L-sit
exercises.note: Hands down and hips lifted, heels resting on the floor.

exercises.name: Seated straddle leg lift
exercises.note: Sit in a wide straddle with the hands between the legs and lift the heels.

exercises.name: Tuck L-sit
exercises.note: Hands down, hips and feet off the floor, knees tucked.

exercises.name: Advanced tuck L-sit
exercises.note: A tuck L-sit with the knees pushed out away from the chest.

exercises.name: One-leg L-sit
exercises.note: One leg straight out, the other tucked.

exercises.name: Hanging L-sit
exercises.note: Hang from a bar with the straight legs held horizontal.

exercises.name: L-sit
exercises.note: Hands down, arms straight, legs straight out in front at hip height.

exercises.name: Ring L-sit
exercises.note: An L-sit on rings.

exercises.name: Straddle L-sit
exercises.note: Legs straight and wide with the hands between them, hips lifted.

exercises.name: V-sit
exercises.note: An L-sit with the legs raised well above horizontal.

exercises.name: Manna
exercises.note: Seated hold with the hips lifted and pushed forward past the hands and the legs raised toward the face, arms straight behind.

exercises.name: Stomach vacuum
exercises.note: Exhale fully and draw the navel in toward the spine; hold.

exercises.name: Pelvic floor contraction
exercises.note: Squeeze and lift the pelvic floor, hold, then fully relax.

exercises.name: Diaphragmatic breathing
exercises.note: Breathe low into the belly and sides while the chest stays quiet.

exercises.name: Shoulderstand squat
exercises.note: Lying on the upper back with the legs overhead, bend the knees toward the forehead and straighten them.

exercises.name: Jackknife squat
exercises.note: Hands on a knee-high support in front; bend at the hips and knees to squat, helping with the arms.

exercises.name: Assisted squat
exercises.note: Hold a door frame, pole or rings and squat deep, using the arms as needed.

exercises.name: Box squat
exercises.note: Sit back to touch a box or chair, then stand.

exercises.name: Half squat
exercises.note: Squat until the knees bend to about 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.note: Feet about shoulder width; sit the hips down between the heels, thighs below parallel if you can.

exercises.name: Prisoner squat
exercises.note: Hands behind the head, elbows pulled back.

exercises.name: Sumo squat
exercises.note: Wide stance with the toes turned out.

exercises.name: Close squat
exercises.note: Feet together or nearly so.

exercises.name: Hindu squat
exercises.note: Heels rise at the bottom as the arms swing back, then drive up as they swing forward; done for high reps.

exercises.name: Uneven squat
exercises.note: One foot raised on a block or ball so the lower leg does most of the work.

exercises.name: Assisted pistol squat
exercises.note: Hold a door frame, pole or rings and use the arms as needed.

exercises.name: Box pistol squat
exercises.note: Single-leg squat down to a box or bench and back up.

exercises.name: Beginner shrimp squat
exercises.note: Lower until the rear knee touches the floor, the rear toes touching too; arms forward for balance.

exercises.name: Skater squat
exercises.note: Lower the free knee toward the floor behind you with the torso leaning forward.

exercises.name: Elevated pistol squat
exercises.note: Stand on a box so the free leg can drop below it at the bottom.

exercises.name: Pistol squat
exercises.note: Squat all the way down on one leg with the other held straight out in front.

exercises.name: Intermediate shrimp squat
exercises.note: Touch down with the rear knee alone, the rear toes kept off the floor.

exercises.name: Advanced shrimp squat
exercises.note: Hold the rear foot with the same-side hand and touch down with the knee.

exercises.name: Two-hand shrimp squat
exercises.note: Hold the rear foot with both hands behind the back and touch down with the knee.

exercises.name: Deficit shrimp squat
exercises.note: Shrimp squat standing on a step so the knee travels below the foot.

exercises.name: Dragon pistol squat
exercises.note: A pistol with the free leg passed behind and around the standing leg.

exercises.name: Hawaiian squat
exercises.note: Single-leg squat with the free ankle resting on the standing thigh in a figure-4.

exercises.name: Split squat
exercises.note: Staggered stance; drop the back knee straight down toward the floor.

exercises.name: Forward lunge
exercises.note: Step forward into a lunge and push back to standing.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.note: Step back into a lunge and return.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.note: Lunge forward step after step.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge
exercises.note: Step wide to the side and sit into that hip, the other leg straight.

exercises.name: Curtsy lunge
exercises.note: Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge knee drive
exercises.note: Step back into a lunge, then drive the back knee up to hip height as you stand.

exercises.name: Clock lunge
exercises.note: Lunge forward, sideways and back in turn, like the hands of a clock.

exercises.name: Deficit reverse lunge
exercises.note: Stand on a low step and lunge back to the floor for extra depth.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.note: Rear foot on a bench behind you; drop the back knee toward the floor.

exercises.name: Front-foot-elevated split squat
exercises.note: Front foot on a low step for a deeper range.

exercises.name: ATG split squat
exercises.note: Long split stance with the front knee pushed far past the toes and the rear leg nearly straight.

exercises.name: Cossack squat
exercises.note: Wide stance; sit deep into one hip with the other leg straight and its toes up.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.note: Step onto a box, stand tall, then step down.

exercises.name: Lateral step-up
exercises.note: Box beside you; step up sideways.

exercises.name: Crossover step-up
exercises.note: Step up across the body onto a box on the far side.

exercises.name: Step-down
exercises.note: Stand on a step and slowly lower the other heel to the floor, then stand back up.

exercises.name: Deep step-up
exercises.note: Step-up onto a box high enough that the thigh starts above parallel.

exercises.name: Poliquin step-up
exercises.note: Working heel raised on a wedge atop a low step; bend the knee forward to lower the other heel, then stand.

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.note: Back against the wall with the thighs parallel to the floor; hold.

exercises.name: Horse stance
exercises.note: Very wide stance, thighs near parallel, torso upright; hold.

exercises.name: Chair pose
exercises.note: A shallow standing squat held with the arms raised overhead.

exercises.name: Single-leg wall sit
exercises.note: A wall sit with one foot lifted.

exercises.name: Sissy squat
exercises.note: Holding a support, rise onto the toes and lean back as the knees travel forward and down.

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic curl
exercises.note: Kneeling upright, lean the whole body back from the knees, then return.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.note: On the back with knees bent, drive the hips up until the body is straight from knees to shoulders.

exercises.name: Glute bridge march
exercises.note: Hold the bridge and lift the feet alternately.

exercises.name: Frog pump
exercises.note: A glute bridge with the soles together and the knees out.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated glute bridge
exercises.note: Heels on a box or bench.

exercises.name: Tabletop bridge
exercises.note: Hands and feet on the floor, knees at 90 degrees, hips lifted into a flat table.

exercises.name: Reverse plank
exercises.note: Seated with the hands behind, lift the hips until the body is straight, face up.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.note: A bridge on one leg, the other held straight in line with the body or tucked.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.note: Upper back on a bench; drive the hips up to full extension.

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.note: A hip thrust on one leg.

exercises.name: Hamstring bridge
exercises.note: Heels on a box with the knees nearly straight; lift the hips.

exercises.name: Hamstring walkout
exercises.note: From a glute bridge, walk the heels out until the legs are nearly straight, then walk back.

exercises.name: Sliding leg curl
exercises.note: Bridge up with the heels on sliders, slide the feet out and curl them back in.

exercises.name: Ring leg curl
exercises.note: Heels in rings or straps with the hips lifted; curl the heels toward the hips.

exercises.name: Nordic curl negative
exercises.note: Kneeling with the ankles anchored, lower the body toward the floor as slowly as possible and catch with the hands.

exercises.name: Single-leg sliding leg curl
exercises.note: A sliding leg curl on one leg.

exercises.name: Nordic hamstring curl
exercises.note: Lower and raise the straight body from the knees using only the hamstrings.

exercises.name: Glute-ham raise
exercises.note: On a GHD, lower the straight body from the knees and curl back up.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.note: On hands and knees, reach the opposite arm and leg out long, then switch.

exercises.name: Bodyweight good morning
exercises.note: Hands behind the head; hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, then stand.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.note: Hinge forward on one leg as the other reaches back, then stand.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.note: Face down, lift the arms, chest and legs off the floor, then lower.

exercises.name: Arch body hold
exercises.note: Face down, hold the arms and legs lifted in a long banana shape.

exercises.name: Swimmer
exercises.note: Face down, flutter the opposite arm and leg up and down.

exercises.name: Prone leg raise
exercises.note: Face down, lift the straight legs off the floor.

exercises.name: Donkey kick
exercises.note: On hands and knees, drive one bent leg up and back.

exercises.name: Back extension
exercises.note: On a 45-degree or horizontal bench, lower the torso and raise it back in line with the legs.

exercises.name: Arch rock
exercises.note: Rock back and forth while holding the arch shape.

exercises.name: Hip airplane
exercises.note: Hinged forward on one leg, rotate the pelvis open to the side and back closed.

exercises.name: Reverse hyperextension
exercises.note: Torso on a bench or table with the hips at the edge; raise the straight legs to horizontal.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.note: Side-lying with the knees bent, open the top knee without rolling the hips back.

exercises.name: Fire hydrant
exercises.note: On hands and knees, lift one bent leg out to the side.

exercises.name: Side-lying leg raise
exercises.note: Lying on one side, lift the straight top leg.

exercises.name: Side-lying adductor raise
exercises.note: Lying on one side, lift the bottom leg.

exercises.name: Hip hike
exercises.note: Stand on one leg on a step; let the free hip drop, then lift it using the standing hip.

exercises.name: Seated knee lift
exercises.note: Sitting tall on a bench, lift one knee above hip level and hold briefly.

exercises.name: Short-lever Copenhagen plank
exercises.note: Side plank with the top knee on a bench and the bottom leg hanging free.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank
exercises.note: Side plank with the top foot on a bench and the bottom leg free.

exercises.name: Copenhagen adduction
exercises.note: From the Copenhagen plank, lower the body and lift it back with the top leg.

exercises.name: Double-leg calf raise
exercises.note: Rise onto the balls of both feet, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bent-knee calf raise
exercises.note: Knees bent throughout, which shifts the work to the soleus.

exercises.name: Deficit calf raise
exercises.note: Balls of the feet on a step, heels dropping below it at the bottom.

exercises.name: Eccentric heel drop
exercises.note: Rise on both feet, then lower slowly on one with the heel sinking below the step.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.note: A calf raise on one leg, a hand on the wall for balance.

exercises.name: Single-leg deficit calf raise
exercises.note: A single-leg calf raise from a step with a full stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Tibialis raise
exercises.note: Back against a wall with the heels forward of the hips; lift the toes and forefoot as high as possible.

exercises.name: Heel walk
exercises.note: Walk on the heels with the toes lifted.

exercises.name: Toe walk
exercises.note: Walk on the balls of the feet with the heels high.

exercises.name: Backward walk
exercises.note: Walk backward, pushing off the balls of the feet.

exercises.name: Short foot
exercises.note: Draw the ball of the foot toward the heel to lift the arch without curling the toes.

exercises.name: Toe yoga
exercises.note: Lift the big toe while the others stay down, then swap.

exercises.name: Toe spread
exercises.note: Spread the toes as wide as possible and hold.

exercises.name: Towel scrunch
exercises.note: Pull a towel toward you along the floor using only the toes.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance
exercises.note: Stand on one leg; progress with the eyes closed or on a soft surface.

exercises.name: Chin tuck
exercises.note: Glide the head straight back into a double chin, then release.

exercises.name: Hand-resisted neck isometric
exercises.note: Press the head into your hand forward, back and to each side without letting it move.

exercises.name: Lying neck curl
exercises.note: On the back (head off a bench edge, if you use one), tuck the chin and lift the head.

exercises.name: Prone neck extension
exercises.note: Face down (head off a bench edge, if you use one), lift the head back.

exercises.name: Side-lying neck raise
exercises.note: Lying on one side, lift the head toward the ceiling.

exercises.name: Wall neck bridge
exercises.note: Lean the head against a padded wall, front, back and each side in turn, holding part of your weight.

exercises.name: Front neck bridge
exercises.note: Face down on the forehead and toes, hands nearby for support; build up gradually.

exercises.name: Wrestler's bridge
exercises.note: Arched back, weight on the back of the head and the feet; use the hands at first, and skip it with a neck problem.

exercises.name: Neck bridge rock
exercises.note: In a front or back neck bridge, rock forward and back over the head.

exercises.name: Horizontal hang
exercises.note: Hang under a low bar with straight arms and a straight body, heels on the floor.

exercises.name: One-arm dead hang
exercises.note: Hang from one hand with the shoulder engaged.

exercises.name: Towel hang
exercises.note: Hang from one or two towels draped over the bar.

exercises.name: Ledge hang
exercises.note: Hang from the fingertips on a ledge, the top of a door frame or a hangboard.

exercises.name: One-arm towel hang
exercises.note: Hang from a single towel with one hand.

exercises.name: Ledge shimmy
exercises.note: Traverse sideways along a ledge hanging from the fingertips.

exercises.name: Towel wring
exercises.note: Twist a rolled towel hard in both directions, as if wringing it out.

exercises.name: Back-of-hand push-up
exercises.note: Push-up on the backs of the hands, fingers pointing toward each other; build up from the knees.

exercises.name: Two-finger push-up
exercises.note: Push-up on the thumb and index finger of each hand; the one-arm version is a famous feat.

exercises.name: Pogo hop
exercises.note: Quick, stiff-legged hops off the balls of the feet.

exercises.name: Squat jump
exercises.note: Squat, then jump as high as possible and land softly back into the squat.

exercises.name: Countermovement jump
exercises.note: Dip quickly and jump straight up, reaching overhead.

exercises.name: High jumper
exercises.note: Swing the arms back and forth with small hops, taking a higher jump every few reps (Army drill).

exercises.name: Star jump
exercises.note: Jump up spreading the arms and legs into an X, then land with the feet together.

exercises.name: Rotational jump
exercises.note: Jump and turn 90, 180 or 360 degrees, landing in balance.

exercises.name: Split jump
exercises.note: From a lunge, jump and switch legs in the air.

exercises.name: Tuck jump
exercises.note: Jump and pull the knees to the chest.

exercises.name: Pike jump
exercises.note: Jump and lift the straight legs forward to reach for the toes.

exercises.name: Butt-kick jump
exercises.note: Jump and kick the heels up to the glutes.

exercises.name: Heel-click jump
exercises.note: Jump and click the heels together in the air.

exercises.name: Kneeling jump
exercises.note: From kneeling, swing the arms and jump up onto the feet.

exercises.name: Single-leg hop
exercises.note: Repeated hops on one leg in place.

exercises.name: Single-leg tuck jump
exercises.note: A tuck jump taking off and landing on one leg.

exercises.name: Jumping pistol squat
exercises.note: A pistol squat that explodes into a one-leg jump.

exercises.name: Frog jump
exercises.note: From a deep squat with the hands down, jump forward and land back in the squat.

exercises.name: Bunny hop
exercises.note: Continuous small two-footed hops forward.

exercises.name: Lateral hop
exercises.note: Hop side to side over a line with both feet.

exercises.name: Broad jump
exercises.note: Swing the arms and jump forward as far as possible, landing on both feet.

exercises.name: Skater jump
exercises.note: Bound sideways from one foot to the other, the trailing leg swinging behind.

exercises.name: Quadrant jump
exercises.note: Jump around a square pattern (forward, sideways, back, sideways) on both feet or one.

exercises.name: Hurdle hop
exercises.note: Jump continuously over a row of low obstacles such as cones.

exercises.name: Standing triple jump
exercises.note: From a standing start: hop, step, then jump into a two-foot landing.

exercises.name: Bounding
exercises.note: Exaggerated running strides, driving the knee up and hanging in the air as long as possible.

exercises.name: Single-leg bound
exercises.note: Repeated long hops on the same leg for distance.

exercises.name: A-skip
exercises.note: Skip with a high knee drive and an active, pawing foot strike.

exercises.name: Power skip
exercises.note: Skip for maximum height, driving the knee and the opposite arm up.

exercises.name: Lateral skip
exercises.note: Skip sideways, pushing off the trailing foot.

exercises.name: Backward skip
exercises.note: Skip moving backward.

exercises.name: B-skip
exercises.note: An A-skip that extends the lead leg forward before pawing it back down.

exercises.name: Box push-off
exercises.note: One foot on a box, push off it to jump as high as possible and land with the same or other foot up.

exercises.name: Lateral box push-off
exercises.note: Box beside you: push off the top foot, jump across the box and land with the other foot on top.

exercises.name: Box jump
exercises.note: Jump from the floor onto a box, landing softly; step down.

exercises.name: Seated box jump
exercises.note: From seated on a bench, jump straight onto a box.

exercises.name: Lateral box jump
exercises.note: Jump sideways onto a box.

exercises.name: Box jump-over
exercises.note: Jump onto and over a box, or clear it completely.

exercises.name: Depth drop
exercises.note: Step off a box and stick the landing.

exercises.name: Depth jump
exercises.note: Step off a box and rebound into a maximal jump the instant you land.

exercises.name: Depth jump to box
exercises.note: Step off one box and rebound straight onto a second.

exercises.name: Single-leg box jump
exercises.note: Jump onto a box taking off and landing on one leg.

exercises.name: Single-leg depth jump
exercises.note: Step off a low box onto one leg and rebound into a jump.

exercises.name: Jumping jack
aka: Half jack (arms only to shoulder height)
exercises.note: Jump the feet wide as the arms swing overhead, then back together.

exercises.name: Step jack
exercises.note: Step one foot out at a time as the arms rise: a jack without the jump.

exercises.name: Seal jack
exercises.note: A jumping jack with the arms opening wide and clapping together in front at chest height.

exercises.name: Cross jack
exercises.note: Jump the feet out, then cross them as they land, alternating which foot is in front.

exercises.name: Split jack
exercises.note: Jump between split stances, switching the front foot, while the opposite arm swings forward.

exercises.name: Squat jack
exercises.note: Jump the feet wide into a squat, then back together.

exercises.name: Plank jack
exercises.note: In a high plank, jump the feet out and in.

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.note: Run in place or forward, driving the knees to hip height.

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.note: Run in place, kicking the heels up to the glutes.

exercises.name: Running in place
exercises.note: Jog on the spot, lifting the feet clear of the floor.

exercises.name: Fast feet
exercises.note: Tiny, rapid steps on the balls of the feet in a low athletic stance.

exercises.name: Shadow boxing
exercises.note: Throw punch combinations in the air while moving the feet.

exercises.name: Lateral shuffle
exercises.note: Stay low and shuffle sideways without crossing the feet.

exercises.name: Carioca
exercises.note: Move sideways, crossing the trailing foot alternately in front of and behind the lead foot.

exercises.name: Shuttle run
exercises.note: Sprint back and forth between two lines, touching each line at the turn.

exercises.name: Mountain climber
exercises.note: In a high plank, drive the knees toward the chest in a running rhythm.

exercises.name: Incline mountain climber
exercises.note: Hands on a bench for an easier angle.

exercises.name: Cross-body mountain climber
exercises.note: Drive each knee toward the opposite elbow.

exercises.name: Slider mountain climber
exercises.note: Slide the feet alternately on sliders instead of lifting them.

exercises.name: Squat thrust
exercises.note: Squat, hands down, jump the feet back to a plank, jump them in, stand.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.note: A squat thrust with a push-up at the bottom and a jump at the top.

exercises.name: Sprawl
exercises.note: Drop the hips to the floor as the legs shoot back, then snap back up to standing.

exercises.name: Up-down
exercises.note: Run in place, drop flat to the chest, then pop straight back up and keep running.

exercises.name: Eight-count bodybuilder
exercises.note: A squat thrust with a push-up, plus opening and closing the feet in the plank.

exercises.name: Lateral burpee
exercises.note: Jump sideways over a line or low object after each burpee.

exercises.name: Burpee broad jump
exercises.note: Broad jump forward out of every burpee.

exercises.name: Burpee tuck jump
exercises.note: Finish each burpee with a tuck jump.

exercises.name: Burpee box jump
exercises.note: Jump onto a box at the top of each burpee.

exercises.name: Burpee pull-up
exercises.note: Jump to a pull-up at the top of each burpee.

exercises.name: Single-leg burpee
exercises.note: A burpee done entirely on one leg.

exercises.name: Baby crawl
exercises.note: Crawl on hands and knees, moving opposite hand and knee together.

exercises.name: Bear crawl
exercises.note: On hands and feet with the knees just off the floor, move opposite limbs together in any direction.

exercises.name: Crab walk
exercises.note: Face up on hands and feet with the hips lifted, walk in any direction.

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.note: From standing, walk the hands out to a plank, then walk the feet up to the hands.

exercises.name: Duck walk
exercises.note: Walk while staying in a deep squat.

exercises.name: Monkey walk
exercises.note: From a deep squat, place both hands to one side and hop the feet over past them.

exercises.name: Frogger
exercises.note: Hands on the floor in front; hop the feet up outside the hands into a deep squat, chest up, then reach forward again.

exercises.name: Wheelbarrow walk
exercises.note: Walk on the hands while a partner holds your legs.

exercises.name: Army crawl
exercises.note: Face down, pull with the forearms and push with the legs, belly on the ground.

exercises.name: High crawl
exercises.note: On the forearms and knees with the body off the ground, moving opposite elbow and knee together.

exercises.name: Lame dog walk
exercises.note: Crawl on both hands and one foot, the other leg held up behind.

exercises.name: Leopard crawl
exercises.note: A bear crawl with the hips and knees very low, just off the floor.

exercises.name: Lizard crawl
exercises.note: Crawl at the bottom of a push-up, bringing each knee up toward its elbow.

exercises.name: Seal walk
exercises.note: In a high plank with the legs relaxed, walk forward on the hands, dragging the feet.

exercises.name: Loaded beast
exercises.note: From the beast (hands and feet, knees hovering), rock the hips back toward the heels and forward again.

exercises.name: Crab reach
exercises.note: From a static crab, drive the hips up and reach one arm overhead and behind into a backbend.

exercises.name: Scorpion reach
exercises.note: From loaded beast, shift forward, then circle one bent leg out and up behind you, shin to the sky, spine twisting like a scorpion tail.

exercises.name: Underswitch
exercises.note: From the beast, thread one leg under the body and turn over into a crab, then switch back.

exercises.name: Side kickthrough
exercises.note: From the beast, rotate and kick one leg through under the body while the opposite hand lifts.

exercises.name: Forward roll
exercises.note: Tuck the chin, place the hands and roll over the backs of the shoulders to stand.

exercises.name: Backward roll
exercises.note: Sit back and roll over the shoulders, hands pushing beside the ears, to land on the feet.

exercises.name: Shoulder roll
exercises.note: Roll diagonally across one shoulder and the back, as in parkour and martial arts.

exercises.name: Cartwheel
exercises.note: Hand, hand, foot, foot: travel sideways through a straddled handstand.

exercises.name: Dive roll
exercises.note: Jump forward into a forward roll, the hands catching first.

exercises.name: Handstand forward roll
exercises.note: From a handstand, bend the arms, tuck the chin and roll out.

exercises.name: One-handed cartwheel
exercises.note: A cartwheel using only the lead hand.

exercises.name: Round-off
exercises.note: A cartwheel that snaps the legs together and lands facing back the way you came.

exercises.name: Bridge kickover
exercises.note: From a bridge, kick one leg over and push through the shoulders to stand.

exercises.name: Kip-up
exercises.note: From lying on the back, roll back and snap the hips forward to land on the feet.

exercises.name: Macaco
exercises.note: Capoeira move: from a crouch, reach one hand back and swing over it, landing on the feet.

exercises.name: Front walkover
exercises.note: Pass through a handstand into a bridge, then stand up out of it.

exercises.name: Back walkover
exercises.note: Arch back from standing into a bridge and kick the legs over to stand.

exercises.name: Backward roll to handstand
exercises.note: Roll backward and push straight up through the arms into a handstand.

exercises.name: Aerial
exercises.note: A cartwheel without the hands.

exercises.name: Front handspring
exercises.note: Run, reach into a handstand and block off the shoulders to spring over to the feet.

exercises.name: Back handspring
exercises.note: Sit back, jump backward onto the hands and snap the legs over to land.

exercises.name: Front flip
exercises.note: Jump and rotate forward through a tuck to land on the feet.

exercises.name: Back flip
exercises.note: Jump straight up and rotate backward through a tuck to land on the feet.

exercises.name: Side flip
exercises.note: A flip that rotates sideways through a tuck or straddle.

exercises.name: No-hands kip-up
exercises.note: A kip-up done without pushing off the floor with the hands.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.note: On hands and knees, alternate rounding and arching the spine.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.note: Kneel, sit back on the heels and fold forward with the arms reaching ahead.

exercises.name: Cobra
exercises.note: Face down with the hands under the shoulders, press the chest up while the hips stay down.

exercises.name: Upward-facing dog
exercises.note: Face down, press up onto straight arms so the hips, thighs and knees lift off the floor, tops of the feet down.

exercises.name: Open book
exercises.note: Lying on one side with the knees bent, rotate the top arm and upper back open to the other side.

exercises.name: Thread the needle
exercises.note: On hands and knees, reach one arm under the body, then open it up toward the ceiling.

exercises.name: Angled bridge
exercises.note: A bridge with the hands on a bench or bed, making the arch easier.

exercises.name: Jefferson curl
exercises.note: Standing on a box or the floor, roll down one vertebra at a time toward the toes, then roll back up.

exercises.name: Bow pose
exercises.note: Face down, hold the ankles and lift the chest and thighs.

exercises.name: Camel pose
exercises.note: Kneeling upright, arch back to reach the hands to the heels with the hips pushed forward.

exercises.name: Full bridge
exercises.note: From the back, press up on the hands and feet into a full arch with straight arms.

exercises.name: Head bridge
exercises.note: A bridge supported on the hands, feet and top of the head.

exercises.name: Wall walk-down bridge
exercises.note: Back to a wall, walk the hands down it into a bridge.

exercises.name: One-leg bridge
exercises.note: A full bridge with one leg raised.

exercises.name: One-arm bridge
exercises.note: A full bridge with one arm lifted.

exercises.name: Wall walk-up bridge
exercises.note: From a bridge, walk the hands up the wall to stand.

exercises.name: Drop-back bridge
exercises.note: From standing, arch back and lower under control into a bridge.

exercises.name: Stand-to-stand bridge
exercises.note: Drop back into a bridge and come back up to standing without help.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.note: Sit in the bottom of a squat with the heels down and the chest up; hold.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switch
exercises.note: Seated with both knees bent 90 degrees to one side, rotate them over to the other side.

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.note: From a deep lunge, drop the inside elbow toward the instep, then rotate that arm to the ceiling.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.note: Rear knee at the base of a wall with the shin up it, front foot forward; lift the chest.

exercises.name: Frog stretch
exercises.note: On the forearms and knees with the knees wide, sink the hips back.

exercises.name: Butterfly stretch
exercises.note: Seated with the soles together, let the knees fall open and fold forward.

exercises.name: Pigeon pose
exercises.note: Front shin angled across the body, back leg straight; fold over the front leg.

exercises.name: Downward dog
exercises.note: From hands and knees, push the hips up and back into an inverted V with the heels reaching down.

exercises.name: Pike stretch
exercises.note: Seated with the legs straight together, fold forward from the hips.

exercises.name: Plough pose
exercises.note: On the back, bring the straight legs over the head to touch the floor behind.

exercises.name: Pancake stretch
exercises.note: Seated in a wide straddle, fold the chest forward toward the floor from the hips.

exercises.name: Front split
exercises.note: One leg straight forward and the other straight back, hips square, sitting all the way down.

exercises.name: Middle split
exercises.note: Legs straight out to the sides with the hips sinking to the floor.

exercises.name: Arm circles
exercises.note: Straight arms out to the sides; circle forward and backward, small to large.

exercises.name: Shoulder CARs
exercises.note: Draw the largest possible circle with one straight arm, slowly, keeping the torso still.

exercises.name: Shoulder dislocate
exercises.note: Hold a broomstick or band wide and pass it over the head from the front of the hips to behind, arms straight.

exercises.name: Wrist circles
exercises.note: Circle the wrists slowly in both directions.

exercises.name: Wrist rocks
exercises.note: On hands and knees, rock forward and back over the hands with the fingers pointing forward, sideways and back in turn.

exercises.name: Palm pulses
exercises.note: On hands and knees, lift the heels of the hands and lower them, fingers staying down.

exercises.name: Finger pulses
exercises.note: On hands and knees, rise onto the fingertips and lower back down.

exercises.name: Neck CARs
exercises.note: Roll the head slowly through its full range in both directions.

exercises.name: Hip CARs
exercises.note: Standing or on hands and knees, draw the largest possible circle with the knee while the pelvis stays still.

exercises.name: Standing hip circles
exercises.note: Hands on the hips; circle the pelvis in both directions.

exercises.name: Leg swings
exercises.note: Holding a support, swing one straight leg forward and back, then side to side.

exercises.name: Squat sky reach
exercises.note: From a deep squat holding the toes, reach one arm and then both to the ceiling, then stand.

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle mobilization
exercises.note: Half kneeling facing a wall, drive the front knee forward over the toes without lifting the heel.

exercises.name: Ankle circles
exercises.note: Lift one foot and circle the ankle both ways, or trace the alphabet with the toes.

exercises.name: Walking knee hug
exercises.note: Step forward and pull one knee to the chest while rising onto the standing toes.

exercises.name: Straight-leg kick
exercises.note: Kick one straight leg up toward the opposite hand, walking or in place.

exercises.name: Bend and reach
exercises.note: Squat slightly and reach the arms back between the legs, then rise and reach overhead (Army drill).

exercises.name: Squat bender
exercises.note: Alternate a half squat with the arms reaching forward and a flat-back forward bend with soft knees, reaching toward the ground (Army drill).

exercises.name: Windmill
exercises.note: Feet wide and arms out, bend and rotate to touch each hand to the opposite foot.

exercises.name: Standing toe touch
exercises.note: From standing, bend forward to reach toward the toes, then stand.

exercises.name: Standing side bend
exercises.note: Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways, alternating sides.

exercises.name: The Hundred
exercises.note: Curl up with the legs raised and pump the straight arms up and down for 100 counts while breathing.

exercises.name: Roll-up
exercises.note: Lying with the arms overhead, roll up through the spine to reach for the toes, then roll back down.

exercises.name: Roll-over
exercises.note: Swing the legs overhead until the toes touch the floor behind, then roll back down with control.

exercises.name: One-leg circle
exercises.note: On the back with one leg to the ceiling, circle it without rocking the pelvis.

exercises.name: Rolling like a ball
exercises.note: Balance in a tight tuck, roll back to the shoulder blades and up again.

exercises.name: Single-leg stretch
exercises.note: Curled up, pull one knee in while the other leg extends, switching in rhythm.

exercises.name: Double-leg stretch
exercises.note: Curled up, reach the arms and legs away together, then circle the arms and hug the knees.

exercises.name: Spine stretch forward
exercises.note: Sitting with the legs apart, round forward one vertebra at a time, then restack.

exercises.name: Open-leg rocker
exercises.note: Balance holding the ankles with the legs in a V, then roll back and up.

exercises.name: Corkscrew
exercises.note: With the legs together overhead, circle them side to side with control.

exercises.name: Saw
exercises.note: Seated with the legs wide, twist and reach one hand past the opposite little toe.

exercises.name: Swan dive
exercises.note: From a face-down backbend, rock forward and back on the front of the body.

exercises.name: Single-leg kick
exercises.note: Face down on the forearms, kick one heel to the glute twice, then switch.

exercises.name: Double-leg kick
exercises.note: Face down with the hands clasped behind, kick both heels in, then lift the chest and reach back.

exercises.name: Neck pull
exercises.note: A slow roll-up with the hands behind the head and the legs apart.

exercises.name: Pilates scissors
exercises.note: With the hips supported high, split the legs forward and back like scissors.

exercises.name: Pilates bicycle
exercises.note: With the hips supported high, pedal the legs in a large bicycle motion.

exercises.name: Pilates shoulder bridge
exercises.note: In a bridge, kick one straight leg up and lower it while the hips stay high.

exercises.name: Spine twist
exercises.note: Seated tall with the arms out, twist the torso side to side.

exercises.name: Pilates jackknife
exercises.note: Roll the legs overhead, press them straight up to the ceiling, then roll down.

exercises.name: Side kick
exercises.note: Lying on one side, kick the top leg forward and back.

exercises.name: Teaser
exercises.note: Roll up into a V balance with the legs and arms reaching up; hold, then roll down.

exercises.name: Hip twist
exercises.note: Seated leaning back on the hands, circle the straight legs together.

exercises.name: Swimming
exercises.note: Face down, flutter the opposite arm and leg in quick alternation; the Pilates form of the swimmer.

exercises.name: Leg pull front
exercises.note: In a high plank, lift one straight leg and push back through the standing heel.

exercises.name: Leg pull back
exercises.note: In a reverse plank, kick one straight leg up toward the ceiling.

exercises.name: Kneeling side kick
exercises.note: Kneeling on one knee with a hand down, kick the top leg forward and back.

exercises.name: Pilates side bend
exercises.note: From sitting on one hip, lift into a side plank arching up and over.

exercises.name: Boomerang
exercises.note: Roll over with the legs crossed, switch the cross, roll up to a teaser and sweep the arms behind.

exercises.name: Seal
exercises.note: Balance holding the ankles from inside the knees, clap the feet together, roll back and up.

exercises.name: Pilates crab
exercises.note: Holding the crossed feet, roll back, then forward onto the knees and top of the head.

exercises.name: Rocking
exercises.note: Face down holding the ankles in a bow, rock forward and back.

exercises.name: Control balance
exercises.note: From a roll-over, lift one leg to the ceiling and switch legs, balanced on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Pilates push-up
exercises.note: Roll down from standing, walk out to a plank, do push-ups, walk back and roll up.

modifiers.name: Leverage
modifiers.description: Move the load further from the pivot to make a move harder, or closer to make it easier.
modifiers.examples: incline push-up, push-up, decline push-up; tuck, straddle, full front lever

modifiers.name: Range of motion
modifiers.description: Work through a partial range, the full range, or a deficit range with the hands or feet raised.
modifiers.examples: half push-up, deficit push-up, ATG split squat

modifiers.name: Tempo
modifiers.description: Set a time for each phase (lowering, bottom pause, lifting, top pause), written like 3-1-1-0; X means explosive.

modifiers.name: Pauses & isometric holds
modifiers.description: Stop and hold at any point in the range, most often the hardest point.
modifiers.examples: pause squat, 90-degree pull-up hold, bottom-of-dip hold

modifiers.name: Eccentric only
modifiers.description: Do only the lowering phase, as slowly as possible; builds strength for moves not yet possible.
modifiers.examples: negative pull-up, Nordic curl negative, negative muscle-up

modifiers.name: 1½ reps & partials
modifiers.description: Add a half rep inside each full rep, or finish a set with partial reps in the stretched range.

modifiers.name: Assistance
modifiers.description: Let a band, the feet, a partner, a box or a jump take part of the load.
modifiers.examples: band-assisted pull-up, foot-assisted pistol, jumping muscle-up

modifiers.name: Added load
modifiers.description: Wear a vest, dip belt, backpack or ankle weights. Strictly speaking this is no longer pure bodyweight.

modifiers.name: Unilateral & asymmetric loading
modifiers.description: Shift the work toward one limb: one-arm or one-leg, archer, uneven, staggered or typewriter.
modifiers.examples: archer push-up, uneven pull-up, pistol squat

modifiers.name: Grip & hand position
modifiers.description: Change width, orientation (overhand, underhand, neutral, mixed), false grip, fingertips, knuckles, fists or towels.
modifiers.examples: wide-grip pull-up, false-grip ring row, knuckle push-up

modifiers.name: Stance & foot position
modifiers.description: Change stance width and toe angle, split or stagger the feet, or raise the front or rear foot.

modifiers.name: Surface & stability
modifiers.description: Use rings or straps, one leg, a narrow base or closed eyes so the same move is harder to stabilize.

modifiers.name: Explosive intent
modifiers.description: Move as fast as possible, or add a flight phase with a clap, jump or release.
modifiers.examples: clap push-up, squat jump, clap pull-up

modifiers.name: Kipping or strict
modifiers.description: Use a swing or hip drive for speed and volume, or move strictly with no momentum.

modifiers.name: Plane & direction
modifiers.description: Move forward, backward, sideways or with rotation.
modifiers.examples: lateral lunge, reverse bear crawl, T push-up

modifiers.name: Combinations
modifiers.description: Chain two or more movements into a single rep.
modifiers.examples: burpee pull-up, push-up to shoulder tap, lunge to knee drive

formats.name: Straight sets
formats.description: Fixed sets and reps of one exercise with fixed rest, finished before moving on.

formats.name: Circuit
formats.description: One set of each of several exercises in a row with little rest, repeated for rounds.

formats.name: Superset
formats.description: Two exercises back to back with no rest between, either opposing (push/pull) or the same muscles.

formats.name: Tri-set & giant set
formats.description: Three, or four or more, exercises back to back before resting.

formats.name: Couplet & triplet
formats.description: A workout built from two or three repeated movements.

formats.name: EMOM
formats.description: Start a set at the top of every minute; the rest of the minute is rest.

formats.name: E2MOM & alternating EMOM
formats.description: The same on a 2- or 3-minute clock, or switching movements on odd and even minutes.

formats.name: AMRAP
formats.description: As many rounds or reps as possible in a fixed time; scored in rounds plus reps.

formats.name: For time
formats.description: A fixed amount of work done as fast as possible, usually with a time cap.

formats.name: Chipper
formats.description: A long list of high-rep movements done once through, in order.

formats.name: Buy-in & cash-out
formats.description: A fixed task done before or after the main work.

formats.name: Partition
formats.description: A large rep total split up however you like, or in a fixed pattern.
formats.example: Murph's middle section as 20 rounds of 5/10/15

formats.name: Accumulation
formats.description: Reach a total of reps or hold time in as many sets as it takes.
formats.example: 100 pull-ups in as few sets as possible

formats.name: Tabata
formats.description: 20 s of work and 10 s of rest, 8 times (4 minutes); CrossFit scores the lowest round.

formats.name: HIIT intervals
formats.description: Repeated hard bouts at a fixed work-to-rest ratio.

formats.name: Timed sets
formats.description: Maximum reps of one exercise in a set time.

formats.name: Interval sets
formats.description: At the start of each 1- to 3-minute interval, work close to failure, then rest out the interval.
formats.example: Mark Lauren's You Are Your Own Gym

formats.name: Station rotation
formats.description: A fixed time at each station, rotating on the clock.

formats.name: Ascending ladder
formats.description: Reps climb each set (1, 2, 3 and up) to a target or to just short of failure.

formats.name: Descending ladder & countdown
formats.description: Reps drop each set (10, 9, down to 1).

formats.name: Up-and-down ladder & pyramid
formats.description: Reps climb, then come back down.

formats.name: Density training
formats.description: A fixed block (often 15 minutes) alternating two exercises for as many total reps as possible; beat it next time.

formats.name: Rest-pause
formats.description: Take a set close to failure, rest 10–20 s, and do more reps; repeat once to three times.

formats.name: Myo-reps
formats.description: One set near failure, then mini-sets of 3–5 reps separated by 3–5 deep breaths.

formats.name: Cluster sets
formats.description: A set broken into small groups of 1–5 reps with short rests so every rep stays sharp.

formats.name: Mechanical drop set
formats.description: At or near failure, switch with no rest to an easier version of the same movement.
formats.example: archer push-ups, then push-ups, then incline push-ups

formats.name: Wave loading
formats.description: Repeat a short sequence of sets that gets harder each set, then start again.

formats.name: Grease the Groove
formats.description: Frequent sets of about half your max spread through the day, never near failure.
formats.example: Pavel Tsatsouline's method for pull-ups or pistols

formats.name: Every hour on the hour
formats.description: One set at the top of each hour through the day; Grease the Groove on a clock.

formats.name: Death By
formats.description: An EMOM that adds one rep each minute until you cannot finish the minute.

formats.name: Deck of Cards
formats.description: Each card sets the reps (face value) and its suit picks the exercise; work through the deck.

formats.name: Stappers
formats.description: As many rounds as possible of a short fixed circuit in 20 minutes, reps kept low enough to avoid failing.

formats.name: Max-rep test
formats.description: One all-out set or timed set, used to set or reset a program.

formats.name: Skill-practice block
formats.description: Fresh, high-quality practice of a technical skill, done first and stopped before form breaks down.

formats.name: Complex & flow
formats.description: A fixed chain of movements done back to back without rest; flows stress smooth transitions.

formats.name: Contrast pairing
formats.description: A hard strength version followed straight away by an explosive version of the same pattern.

formats.name: Autoregulation
formats.description: End sets by effort, not a fixed count, such as stopping one or two reps short of failure.

formats.name: Partner formats
formats.description: Alternate turns ("I go, you go"), split the work, or move in sync.

formats.name: Training splits
formats.description: How exercises spread across the week: full body, upper/lower, push/pull/legs, or skill and strength days.

programs.name: RCAF 5BX
programs.summary: 11 minutes a day, five exercises in order: toe-touch stretch (2 min), sit-up (1), back extension (1), push-up (1) and a stationary run with jumps (6). Six charts of 12 levels; each chart uses harder versions (knee push-ups up to chest-slap push-ups). Move up only when all five fit in 11 minutes; the target level is set by age.

programs.name: RCAF XBX
programs.summary: 12 minutes a day, ten exercises: toe touching, knee raising, lateral bending, arm circling, sit-ups, chest and leg raising, side leg raising, push-ups, leg-overs and running in place with jumps. Four charts, 48 levels, target set by age.

programs.name: Convict Conditioning (the Big Six)
programs.summary: Push-up, squat, pull-up, leg raise, bridge and handstand push-up, each a 10-step progression with rep standards for moving up; 2–4 warm-up sets, then 2–3 work sets. Sample programs: New Blood (2 days), Good Behavior (3 days), Veterano (one movement a day), Solitary Confinement (three pairs twice a week, plus grip, calves and neck) and Supermax (10–50 sets per movement). Convict Conditioning 2 (2011) adds grip, flags, calves and neck.

programs.name: Recommended Routine
programs.summary: 3 full-body sessions a week, about an hour. Warm-up, then three strength pairs at 3 × 5–8 with 90 s rest (pull-ups + squats, dips + hinges, rows + push-ups), then a core triplet (anti-extension, anti-rotation, extension) at 3 × 8–12. Tempo 10X0; stop a rep short of failure; move to the next progression at 3 × 8.

programs.name: Minimalist Routine
programs.summary: 2–6 rounds of walking lunges, push-ups, rows and plank shoulder taps with little rest; stop 1–2 reps short of failure; about 3 times a week.

programs.name: One Hundred Push-ups
programs.summary: Test your max, then 6 weeks of 3 sessions a week, 5–9 sets per session with the last set to the max. Columns are chosen by test results; the goal is 100 push-ups in a row. Sister plans cover sit-ups, squats, dips and pull-ups.

programs.name: Armstrong Pull-up Program
programs.summary: Three max sets of push-ups every morning. Pull-ups Monday to Friday: Day 1 five max sets; Day 2 a pyramid (1, 2, 3… to failure); Day 3 nine sets across three grips; Day 4 max training sets; Day 5 repeat the hardest day. Goal: 20 pull-ups in 6–8 weeks.

programs.name: Fighter Pullup Program
programs.summary: A five-set ladder counting down from your max (5-4-3-2-1), adding one rep to one set each day; 5 days on, 1 off, for 30 days, then retest.

programs.name: 7-Minute Workout
programs.summary: 12 exercises for 30 s each with 10 s transitions: jumping jacks, wall sit, push-up, crunch, step-up onto a chair, squat, triceps dip on a chair, plank, high knees, lunge, push-up with rotation, side plank. Repeat 2–3 times if you like.

programs.name: You Are Your Own Gym
programs.summary: Four 10-week programs (Basic, 1st Class, Master Class, Chief Class), about 30 minutes four times a week alternating push/pull and legs/core days, using ladders, supersets, interval sets, timed sets, Tabatas and Stappers.

programs.name: Original Tabata protocol
programs.summary: 7–8 bouts of 20 s at about 170% of VO2max with 10 s rest, to exhaustion, on a braked exercise bike; 5 days a week for 6 weeks. Raised VO2max by about 7 ml/kg/min and anaerobic capacity by 28%. Bodyweight "Tabatas" borrow the timing, not the intensity.

programs.name: Combat Conditioning ("Royal Court")
programs.summary: Hindu squats, Hindu push-ups and the wrestler's bridge. Start squats at 25–50 reps with 500 in a row as a long-term goal; hold the wrestler's bridge for up to 3 minutes.

programs.name: Pehlwani dands and baithaks
programs.summary: Wrestlers train Hindu push-ups (dands) and Hindu squats (baithaks) in the hundreds or thousands; accounts of the Great Gama claim thousands of each daily. Many named dand and baithak variants exist.

programs.name: Walter Camp's Daily Dozen
programs.summary: 12 short mobility drills in four groups (Hands, Hips, Head; Grind, Grate, Grasp; Crawl, Curl, Crouch; Wave, Weave, Wing), about 15 minutes a day.

programs.name: US Army PRT drills
programs.summary: Preparation Drill (bend and reach, rear lunge, high jumper, rower, squat bender, windmill, forward lunge, prone row, bent-leg body twist, push-up); Conditioning Drill 1 (power jump, V-up, mountain climber, leg tuck and twist, single-leg push-up); Conditioning Drill 2 (turn and lunge, supine bicycle, half jacks, swimmer, 8-count push-up); Conditioning Drill 3 (jumping and agility); 4 for the Core (bent-leg raise, side bridge, back bridge, quadraplex); Hip and Shoulder Stability Drills; Climbing Drills on a bar. 5–10 reps each.
